end.parentNote: Rudra practised multiplying numbers with trailing zeros and correctly explained that the zeros are counted after multiplying the non-zero parts. Estimation by rounding was introduced; they were unsure when rounding 6,180 and 480, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise rounding a few numbers to the nearest hundred and thousand, then estimate a product before calculating it.
